summary: Reply is Received in Saleshandy: Create a Note in HubSpot activity adds a Sequence link with the production host (my.saleshandy.com) on Staging
description:
**Prerequisites:**
- Staging account (pyxis.lifeisgoodforlearner.com) connected to HubSpot.
- Reply is Received in Saleshandy trigger enabled with the "Create a Contact in HubSpot" and "Create a Note in HubSpot" activities only.
- Create a Contact in HubSpot: Extra Configuration left empty.
- An active sequence with a prospect that is not a contact in HubSpot.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Add the prospect to the active sequence and wait until the step 1 email is sent.
2. Open the sequence > Emails, open the menu on the prospect's Step 1 email and click Mark as replied.
3. Open API & Integrations > Integrations > HubSpot > Logs and wait for the new "Reply is Received in Saleshandy" entry to show Success.
4. Open the created contact in HubSpot > Activities and read the note "Note created via Saleshandy".

**Actual Result:**
- The workflow shows Success and the note is created on the contact.
- The note's Sequence line is `Sequence: https://my.saleshandy.com/sequence/196293/steps`. It uses the production host (my.saleshandy.com) although the note was created from the Staging account.
- A screenshot will be attached to the ticket manually.

**Expected Result:**
- The Sequence link in the note should use the host of the environment the note was created from.
